tests.name: hasProtocol should return true for "https://example.com" with opts

hasProtocol should return false for "//example.com" with opts
hasProtocol should return true for "//example.com" with opts
hasProtocol should return false for "data:text/plain" with opts
hasProtocol should return false for "/path/to/somewhere" with opts
hasProtocol should support boolean options for backward compatibility
isScriptProtocol should return false for undefined
withBase should return "/foo/bar" for base "/foo" and input "/foo/bar"
withBase should return "/baz/foo/bar" for base "/baz" and input "/foo/bar"
withBase should return "/admin/admin-dashboard" for base "/admin" and input "/admin-dashboard"
withBase should return "/admin/dashboard" for base "/admin" and input "/admin/dashboard"
withBase should return "https://example.com/foo" for base "/foo" and input "https://example.com/foo"
withBase should return "/foo" for base "" and input "/foo"
withoutBase should return "/bar" for base "/foo" and input "/foo/bar"
withoutBase should return "/" for base "/foo" and input "/foo"
withoutBase should return "/baz/foo" for base "/foo" and input "/baz/foo"
withoutBase should return "/admin-dashboard" for base "/admin" and input "/admin-dashboard"
withoutBase should return "/evil.com" for base "/legacy" and input "/legacy//evil.com"
withoutBase should return "/foo" for base "" and input "/foo"
withQuery should add or replace query parameters
getQuery should parse query parameters into an object
isEmptyURL & isNonEmptyURL should correctly identify empty URLs
joinURL should join multiple URL segments
joinRelativeURL should join relative URL segments correctly
withHttp / withHttps / withoutProtocol / withProtocol should manage protocols correctly
normalizeURL should normalize encoding, slashes, and search params
resolveURL should throw TypeError when base is not a string
isSamePath should compare paths ignoring trailing slashes and encoding
isEqual should compare URLs flexibly or strictly
withFragment should add or replace fragments
withoutFragment should remove the fragment section
withoutHost should remove the host from the URL
